answer: An agent selling pigment for a raven mural in a grove accepts payment only with a 2f+1-signature finality certificate from a pinned set of 3f+1 validators. Each key counts once, and honest validators never sign conflicting spends at the same ledger position. Two quorums intersect in at least f+1 validators, so with at most f faulty validators a swarm cannot certify conflicting payments by adding identities. Membership changes require the existing quorum.
